name: Vincent Gaultier
source:
Viscount Gaultier is tall and intimidating, though his grey eyes are darkened with a perpetually haunted look. Cold and even abusive towards his wife and son, he seems utterly detached from those who share his flesh and blood.

However, Vincent acts surprising gentle towards Julien. What drives the icy Viscount to treat his butler with such kindness?

[From the [url=https://mordred-f.jimdo.com/]official site[/url]]
